Man Dies After Falling From Six Flags Roller Coaster in Georgia

A man died after falling from the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia. Several other people were injured in the incident. Following the fatality, Six Flags temporarily closed nine roller coasters across six amusement parks. Guests reported that the man fell from the coaster.
